use: Godot character portraits redrawn from local official reference art

assets.name: 妖刀姬
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait illustration for a Godot card battle game, a single character artwork without any card frame.
Primary request: redraw the character from the supplied original Onmyoji: The Card Game reference with high identity fidelity. The reference is a visual reference only. Create a fresh, higher resolution illustration, not a screenshot enlargement and not a finished card.
Style/medium: closely match the reference's Japanese fantasy card art: elegant clean ink contours, planar cel painted shapes, softly textured washi paper, carefully controlled decorative patterns, muted mineral pigments and restrained antique gold accents. Preserve the reference's stylized anatomy and delicate face. Avoid generic glossy gacha rendering.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3 portrait; character fills the frame, face centered horizontally at around the upper third, complete head fully inside the frame, readable upper body and signature weapon, flowing fabric toward the bottom. Keep important character details within the central 65% of width so a narrow portrait or a landscape card crop still reads. Quiet patterned background closely derived from the reference. 
Constraints: faithfully retain hairstyle, face, costume silhouette, ornaments, signature props and palette in the reference. No words, no symbols copied from the UI, no lettering, no numbers, no nameplate, no card border, no watermark. Do not invent a new outfit. One character only.
Subject: 妖刀姬 / Yoto Hime. Retain her very long black hair with sweeping ribbon-like strands, black lacquered red-accented armor, short pale layered skirt, dark hat/helmet ornaments, enormous black and red sheathed blade, turquoise cord details, long pale legs. Graceful poised side-facing sword-bearing stance. Background: subdued sage and ochre clouds, autumn leaves and a large warm moon like the reference.
